newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Dec yr/yr CPI below 20 pct - c. bank head.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Dec yr/yr CPI below 20 pct - c. bank head.

text.p: National Bank of Hungary President Gyorgy Suranyi predicted on Tuesday that December year-on-year inflation was below 20 percent.
"1996 began with 29 percent inflation, this year with 19," Suranyi said in an interview with the weekly newspaper 168 Ora.
The figures are approximate but confirm recent reports that December year-on-year inflation was below the 20 percent target of the government, down from 20.1 percent in November.
The official CPI figures are published by the Central Statistical Office (KSH). The December figure is likely to be released around January 11.
